limits: Token usage is now recorded both by promptfoo (independent queries) and by the endpoint meter (upstream four-query run). The four-query assertion's own promptfoo counters remain zero placeholders, because the upstream script prints only a matrix and was not modified. Cost remains unreported: promptfoo's cost field is a 0 placeholder, and no per-token price or energy measurement exists for the local vLLM endpoint. This is the remaining arm, so the outcome is advanced. The metric deltas are model-scoped counters; quiet control windows showed no background traffic, but they are not exclusive per-evaluation billing.
